contract.title: Threat Intelligence Dashboard Visual Unification
acceptance_criteria: Only the five explicit Threat Intelligence overview, environment reuse and test paths may change; no global shell, global CSS, Registry, WorkspaceOutlet, navigation, API, model, Explorer, other workspace, backend, provider, runtime or environment path may change.

The immutable visual authority is .ai/references/TASK-0124-product-owner-mockup.png with SHA-256 1ae207282bfa5f23e517f9230cc4ced073d5e1d82e5b862ec38563464cdcee87, dimensions 1402 x 1122 and size 1446764 bytes.

The overview implements the measured Intelligence Snapshot, five compact snapshot instruments, dominant Our Environment panel, neutral Threat Landscape panel, Intelligence Feeds panel and Recent Intelligence panel using the task region table, tolerances and page-local CSS.
Only Relevant Findings may display an exact count derived after successful getFindings loading; its loading, error and empty states remain distinct and no count is shown during loading or error.

Active Campaigns, Threat Actors, New IOCs and High Risk CVEs display truthful unavailable or not-connected states without counts, trends or inferred values; high-risk CVEs are not inferred from finding severity or text.
Our Environment reuses the existing canonical findings and search implementation rather than creating a second parallel implementation or duplicate findings request.

Our Environment continues to search exact canonical Finding ID, title, asset, source and vendor severity fields and navigates a selected finding to /findings?findingId=<encoded-id>&focus=threat-intelligence.
Threat Landscape retains neutral map-stage geometry but renders no colored geography, legend activity, actor or regional claim without an authoritative backend source.
Intelligence Feeds and Recent Intelligence retain the reference panel and list-stage geometry but show explicit truthful unavailable states without illustrative rows, severities or timestamps.

No mockup KPI number, finding, actor, campaign, IOC, CVE, geography, feed, recent-intelligence entry, severity, trend, time comparison or timestamp is copied into productive code or asserted as productive data.
The overview does not automatically execute either threat-intelligence API client or any provider; explicit Explorer and finding-scoped lookup boundaries remain unchanged.
Canonical /threat-intelligence, /threat-intelligence/explorer and /threat-intelligence/environment routes, finding deep links, Back and Forward navigation and URL authority remain passing.
Existing Our Environment loading, error, empty, no-match, search and standalone-page behavior and Explorer on-demand CVE behavior remain passing.
Sidebar, Topbar, WorkspaceSwitcher outside-click and Escape behavior, WorkspaceRegistry, PlatformLayout, WorkspaceOutlet, TASK-0122, TASK-0123 and all other workspaces remain unchanged.

Focused overview tests prove hierarchy, geometry contract, five snapshot state boundaries, loading, error, empty and real findings, shared environment behavior and absence of illustrative fake values.
Full frontend regression, TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass; Scope Guard reports exactly the five allowed paths and all protected reference hashes remain unchanged.
Architect Implementation Review and Product Owner browser acceptance at 1402 x 1122 and 100 percent zoom remain mandatory before DONE.
Do not transition TASK-0124 to DONE or create TASK-0125.
